page_title: PAR 2-3 CAG | Parma v Cagliari 30/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90+5' Dennis Man (Parma) latches onto a loose ball inside the box but slams it high over the bar.
90+5' There's an opportunity for Simon Sohm (Parma) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
90+4' Michel Adopo (Cagliari) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
90+1' Anas Haj Mohamed (Parma) goes into the referee's book. Yellow card.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.

87' 2 - 3 It's in the back of the net! Superb finishing from Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari). Gianluca Gaetano plays a fantastic through ball and finds Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari), who reacts quickly to get in front of the goalkeeper and fire a close-range shot into the left side of the goal. It's now 2:3.
87' 2 - 2 Goal! Hernani (Parma) puts the ball into the bottom right corner past the outstretched arm of Simone Scuffet.
87' Hernani (Parma) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
86' It’s a PENALTY to Parma after the VAR review!

85' Play continues despite the shouts by some Parma players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Francesco Fourneau interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
84' Francesco Fourneau blows his whistle. Jose Luis Palomino (Cagliari) commits a foul after dangerous play. Parma earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
84' Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) spanks one well wide of the left post from the edge of the box.
80' The shot by Pontus Almqvist (Parma) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Simone Scuffet.
79' What a big chance! Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball a whisker wide of the right post.
79' Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) is flagged for offside.
78' Fabio Pecchia has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Anas Haj Mohamed (Parma) replacing Antoine Hainaut.
77' Unlucky! A great strike from Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) near the edge of the box had the keeper scrambling but flew just over the bar.

75' 1 - 2 Michel Adopo looks around to decide who he is going to pass to. He picks out Razvan Marin (Cagliari), who collects the ball perfectly and unleashes a terrific shot that ricochets in off the crossbar. The score is 1:2.
73' The game has come to an end for Yerry Mina. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Jose Luis Palomino (Cagliari).
73' Davide Nicola prepares a substitution. Zito Luvumbo is replaced by Razvan Marin (Cagliari).
72' Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
70' Ange-Yoan Bonny will be replaced by Gabriel Charpentier (Parma).
70' Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies just over the crossbar.
69' Woyo Coulibaly (Parma) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
69' Cagliari are seeing far more of the ball now.
66' Close! Simon Sohm (Parma) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the right post.
64' The substitution is prepared. Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Nicolas Viola.
64' Davide Nicola has decided to make a change. Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) replaces Adam Obert.
63' A goal, which was scored by Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari), was disallowed due to offside.
62' 1 - 1 Goal! Woyo Coulibaly tees up Dennis Man (Parma) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the bottom right corner. 1:1.
61' A substitution has been made. Botond Balogh is replaced by Simon Sohm (Parma).
60' Good chance! Dennis Man (Parma) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored!
59' Parma hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
56' Pontus Almqvist (Parma) shows off his individual ability with a jinking run into the box. Unfortunately, the finish lets him down as the ball flies well wide of the left post.
55' Adam Obert (Cagliari) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Francesco Fourneau blows his whistle for a foul.
53' What was Adam Obert (Cagliari) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
52' Pontus Almqvist (Parma) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
51' Nadir Zortea (Cagliari) bursts pass a defender and attempts to score from the edge of the area, but the shot goes high over the bar.
48' Woyo Coulibaly (Parma) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
48' Dangerous play by Antoine Makoumbou (Cagliari). Francesco Fourneau blows his whistle for a foul.
47' Ange-Yoan Bonny (Parma) latches onto a brilliant cross and fires the ball towards goal, but his shot goes high over the crossbar.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Fabio Pecchia gives a chance to Woyo Coulibaly and Emanuele Valeri (Parma) is off.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Valentin Mihaila (Parma) comes off for Pontus Almqvist.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' Francesco Fourneau blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' Yordan Osorio (Parma) picks up the rebound from his own attempted pass and decides to shoot from mid-range. He shouldn't have bothered as the ball flies miles over the bar.
45+2' Dennis Man (Parma) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
45+1' Valentin Mihaila (Parma) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
44' Hernani (Parma) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
43' Ange-Yoan Bonny (Parma) fires the ball towards goal from outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by one of his teammates.
40' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) has a sight of goal and shoots from long range but his ambitious effort flies just wide of the right post.
37' That was close. Dennis Man (Parma) fires a shot from the edge of the box which goes a whisker wide of the right post.
36' Oh, what a chance! Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) was quickest to the rebound but the ball hit the left post.

34' 0 - 1 Goal! Zito Luvumbo hands Nadir Zortea (Cagliari) the simplest of tasks from close range after the cross evaded the keeper, and he makes no mistake with his header into the right side of the goal. 0:1.
33' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 5:3.
30' Valentin Mihaila (Parma) makes a rough challenge and Francesco Fourneau blows his whistle for a foul.
29' The game is interrupted as Valentin Mihaila (Parma) is flagged offside.
29' Valentin Mihaila (Parma) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
29' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
27' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Zion Suzuki, who smothers the ball.
25' Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
24' Some neat passing and movement from Parma as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
20' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Adam Obert (Cagliari) but poses no threat.
19' Yordan Osorio (Parma) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Francesco Fourneau blows his whistle for a foul.
18' A pass into the penalty area from Valentin Mihaila (Parma) is intercepted by the defence.
16' Parma work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
16' Valentin Mihaila (Parma) receives a pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it towards the left post. Unfortunately for him, Simone Scuffet makes a great save to stop his effort.

15' Michel Adopo (Cagliari) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Francesco Fourneau with no other option than to blow for a foul.
14' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) is caught offside!
13' Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
12' Poor challenge! Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) is penalised for tripping and Francesco Fourneau blows his whistle.
10' Yerry Mina (Cagliari) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
9' Antoine Hainaut (Parma) commits a rough challenge and Francesco Fourneau blows his whistle for a foul.
8' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Cagliari players look gutted.
8' The Cagliari players halt their celebrations as referee Francesco Fourneau makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
6' Goal! Yerry Mina (Cagliari) has the simplest of tasks to roll the ball into an empty net from close range after a rebound left the keeper stranded. 0:1.
6' A cross arrives in the goalmouth from the resulting corner kick. Sebastiano Luperto (Cagliari) outjumps the defence, but his promising header bounces away off the left post!
6' The linesman makes the right call and Cagliari will have a corner.
4' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
3' Antoine Makoumbou (Cagliari) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
3' Cagliari will take a corner kick.
3' Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the left side of the goal is brilliantly kept out by the goalkeeper.
3' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Parma will take the kick-off.
Francesco Fourneau will officiate today.
